title: Browser developer tools: elements, network and console

videos.script: Before you automate a browser, you have to see what the browser sees. {{devtools}} This lesson starts by building your lab. Node, a code editor, and a small shop called quitanda, written for this course. {{shop}} The shop has flaws on purpose. Each one is waiting for the lesson that needs it. {{flaws}} Then you open the developer tools, the same ones in every browser. The Elements panel shows the page as it is now. Not the file the server sent. {{elements}} The Network panel shows every request, and the order they came in. The list of fruit arrives last, after the page is already on screen. Remember that gap. {{network}} The Console shows what went wrong when the screen says nothing. {{console}} And you run your first test. One test, one browser, one green line. {{test}}
